description.narrative: Stakeholders Effects: IFC anticipates that the Project will provide leasing financing for SMEs, facilitating the acquisition of energy efficient equipment and renewable energy sources to reduce carbon dioxide emissions. IFC also anticipates that the Project will provide access to finance for women-inclusive SMEs. At appraisal, the team will explore supporting the Company in providing finance for companies that provide childcare. Contribution to Market Creation: Sustainability: IFC anticipates that the investment will deepen the adoption of climate finance standards, products, and practices by banks and other corporates in the Turkish market through the demonstration channel.

The proposed senior loan of up to US$75 million to Deniz Finansal Kiralama A.S. (Deniz Leasing or the Company) aims to support the Company's strategic decision to: (i) increase its footprint in climate leasing operations (including blue leases), including leases to small and medium enterprises (SMEs) and corporate clients and (ii) support women-owned and women-led SMEs (WSMEs). The Company provides financial leases and operational leases for vehicles fleets to companies, with a market share of 11.4% in terms of leasing assets.
